server.php_flags: -d extension=swoole -d memory_limit=-1 -d opcache.enable_cli=1 -d opcache.jit=tracing -d opcache.jit_buffer_size=32M -d opcache.file_update_protection=0 -d zend.assertions=-1

load.pass_rule: p95 < 500 ms, p99 < 1000 ms, errors < 1 %, achieved >= 97 % of offered

steplab.command: lab/steplab.sh --image 8.5 --rate 7500 --think-scale 0.02 --idle 60000 --seconds 60 --pairs 1 --vu-cap 5400 --variant skeleton=APP_TELEMETRY=1 --variant php-swoole-mattsplat=APP_TELEMETRY=0 --server-variant php-swoole-mattsplat=lab/servers/swoole-entries/php-swoole-mattsplat/server.php --variant-args php-swoole-mattsplat=--image 8.3-apt --ext swoole --label x86-mattsplat --out lab/results/2026-11-23-x86-calibration/mattsplat-pair
